title: Files
purpose: Image-generated visual target based on the current large-surface background; not a runtime screenshot.

layoutIntent.contentWidth: approximately 70% of the scene, left aligned
layoutIntent.foreground: Existing transparent frame covers the content edge
layoutIntent.companion: Keep the existing right-side scene and companion clearance

prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE exquisite final applet design effect for Files, landscape 16:9.
Input image is the CURRENT BACKGROUND EDIT TARGET. Preserve exactly the camera, outer frame silhouette and dimensions, all right-hand scenery, objects, colors, lighting, village buildings and icon-related props. DO NOT redesign or resize the background. Fill the entire existing large blank LEFT surface, approximately 70% of image width and 80% height, with a highly polished, readable and genuinely useful application design. Preserve the existing narrow frame; content meets its inner edge with no extra mat, no large empty margins and no floating inset app window. The original frame is the topmost foreground layer over the content edge.
APPLICATION DESIGN: Beautiful file cabinet index on ivory stock, narrow locations rail, breadcrumb My files / Weekend trip, thumbnail folders and actual document/photo previews with file names and sizes, sort/search/view tools.
Visual quality: beautiful finely textured paper or appropriate game-board material, elegant legible dark ink, tactile linen tabs and shallow embossed brass/wood controls, natural paper edges and small contact shadows lit in exactly the same direction as the scene. Embedded photographs or painted thumbnails where useful, crisp lines and satisfying fine detail. Rich but calm and practical, not flat generic dashboard styling. Content occupies the real usable area generously with balanced density, never a tiny UI in a giant blank board. App-specific content and intentional typography, not decorative filler. Main heading and important controls large enough to read; short realistic English fictional data only.
Implementation-aware: flat front-facing primary content surface, normal aligned rows/cards/text, modest material depth; dynamic text and images could later be rendered in HTML. Do not fragment the working surface into excessive odd shapes. Fill any EXISTING small secondary blank plaque with the relevant date, status or progress stated by the concept; do not create new panels in the scenery. Keep lower-right scene available for the companion, but do NOT draw a fox or character.
Output is one complete image-generated VISUAL CONCEPT, not a photograph of a monitor, not a screenshot and not a collage. No outside browser chrome, watermarks, explanatory labels, laptops, extra pedestals, or dark overlays. Preserve the Village storybook sculpted/painterly aesthetic; no new photorealistic environment. All content fictional. Preserve every existing background edge and right-side detail.
STRICT EDITORIAL REQUIREMENTS: the main app heading must explicitly say "Files". No inspirational quotes, mottos, slogans, heart doodles or decorative filler sentences. Use the space for working information and useful controls instead. Include clear navigation/search/filter controls where appropriate. Match the source image dimensions and keep the frame and right scenery in the same normalized locations.
